sources.title: Sustain AI: A Multi-Modal Deep Learning Framework for Carbon ... - MDPI
sources.snippet: The growing energy demands and increasing environmental concerns in industrial manufacturing necessitate innovative solutions to reduce fuel consumption and lower carbon emissions. This paper presents Sustain AI, a multi-modal deep learning framework that integrates Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for defect detection, Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) for predictive energy consumption ...
